study type: Consensus Document/Clinical Guideline (based on review of observational studies)
exposure: Pregnancy at age 35 years or older
outcome: Adverse pregnancy outcomes (for pregnant patient and fetus)
cohort: The document focuses on pregnant individuals in the United States, specifically women and all those seeking obstetrical care with anticipated delivery at the age of 35 years or older.
finding: Pregnancy in individuals aged 35 years or older is associated with increased risks of adverse pregnancy outcomes, severe maternal morbidity, and mortality, prompting the need for evidence-based clinical recommendations to minimize these risks.
